risks.failure_outcome: Malformed records and available CRC mismatches cannot become fully validated input
limits: Unit coverage is supplemented by full-profile corpus/diagnostic workflows; zero CRC is not an available checksum.

risks.failure_outcome: Selective queries do not silently claim full-file integrity
limits: Unread corruption can remain undetected until full validation.

risks.failure_outcome: Indexes and resumable state reject changed source identity
limits: The frozen producer covers six documented formats; recipe code/runtime changes intentionally require a new job.

risks.failure_outcome: Invalid budgets and ineffective options fail before relevant IO or state mutation
limits: Budgets bound their named resource, not total process RSS.

risks.failure_outcome: Short/zero writes, ENOSPC, sync/close/link and post-commit cleanup failures preserve explicit publication state and unrelated descriptors
limits: Injected syscall outcomes and actual IO do not prove power-loss safety; post-link cleanup errors can leave a complete target.

risks.failure_outcome: Task cancellation and ordinary failures release owned streams/sinks once, retain their distinct terminal states and preserve shared caller resources
limits: Cancellation is cooperative; already accepted host writes cannot be rolled back.

risks.failure_outcome: Interrupted recording does not rewrite committed segments or count an incomplete tail as committed
limits: Actual process termination and recovery windows are tested, not physical storage power interruption.

risks.failure_outcome: Valid-CRC but illegal batch state is rejected; completed artifacts survive idempotent resume
limits: A changed plan must not be forced into an existing job.

risks.failure_outcome: HTTP range/ETag violations, retries and cache corruption cannot be accepted as immutable source bytes
limits: Local controlled HTTP servers do not model every proxy or remote service.

risks.failure_outcome: Worker failures, cancellation, queue and output limits terminate bounded jobs without pretending completion
limits: V8 execution ranges are compiled-host observations, not source-level branch completeness.

risks.failure_outcome: CLI late failures preserve atomic files while stdout partial results remain explicitly unsuccessful
limits: A caller must check exit status; emitted stdout cannot be withdrawn.

risks.failure_outcome: The pinned real-recording example exports the intended messages and labels derived truncation recovery as a partial prefix
limits: The fault is deliberately derived from a public recording; no physical-device or complete-loss-count inference.
